description: This Java interface extends JpaRepository to provide database operations related to Enrollment entities. It includes custom query methods to find enrollments by course ID and user ID.

classes.name: EnrollmentRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for Enrollment entities, providing CRUD operations and custom query methods.

methods.name: findByCourseId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of enrollments associated with a specific course ID.

methods.name: findByCourseIdAndUserId
methods.description: Retrieves an optional enrollment matching both a specific course ID and user ID.

methods.name: findByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of enrollments associated with a specific user ID.
